_note: Outreach samples. Not shown in the public sample cards or the step 1 grid; a link ?sample=<id>#start from an outreach sample picks one. To add a sample, add one entry here (id: outreach-<slug>) and add the id to the sampleId list in v3/backend/firestore.rules. topic and sectionIds are the order form's own values (topic must be one of the five public topics; concept is atelier/brand/studio, chosen like the public sample of the same topic: class→atelier, place→brand; sectionIds are ids from sections.json); the other fields are the sample's description.
